scene: Sharing progress and blockers in a daily stand-up
title_en: Giving a Clear Daily Stand-Up Update
title_cn: 清晰汇报每日站会进展
content_en: Every morning, our development team has a short stand-up meeting to share progress and coordinate the day's work. Each person explains what they completed yesterday, what they plan to do today, and whether anything is blocking their progress. I try to keep my update specific instead of saying that I am simply working on a feature. For example, I might say that I finished the login validation and am now connecting the user profile page to the API. If I have a blocker, I explain what I have tried and what kind of help I need. This makes it easier for a teammate to offer useful advice or take action after the meeting. I also mention risks early, especially when a task may take longer than expected. The goal is not to give a long technical presentation or prove how busy I am. It is a quick way to make sure everyone understands the team's current priorities. If a discussion needs more time, we arrange a separate conversation with the relevant people. A clear update helps the team spot problems early and avoid duplicated work. It also keeps communication open, so small issues do not become serious delays. I usually write down the action items so that everyone knows who is responsible for the next step. If priorities change during the day, I update the team rather than letting others work with outdated information.
content_cn: 每天早上，我们开发团队都会召开简短的站会，分享工作进展并协调当天的任务。每个人都会说明昨天完成了什么、今天计划做什么，以及是否遇到了阻碍工作推进的问题。我会尽量让汇报内容具体，而不是只说自己正在开发某项功能。例如，我可能会说登录验证已经完成，现在正在将用户资料页面与 API 接口连接起来。如果遇到阻碍，我会说明自己已经尝试过哪些方法，以及需要什么帮助。这样，队友就更容易提供有用的建议，或在会议后采取行动。我也会尽早提出风险，尤其是某项任务可能比预期花费更多时间时。站会的目的不是进行冗长的技术演讲，也不是证明自己有多忙。它是一种快速确保所有人了解团队当前工作重点的方式。如果某个问题需要更多时间讨论，我们会安排相关人员单独沟通。清晰的进展汇报能帮助团队及早发现问题，并避免重复劳动。它还能保持沟通畅通，避免小问题逐渐演变成严重的进度延误。我通常会记录后续行动事项，让每个人都清楚下一步由谁负责。如果当天工作重点发生变化，我会及时通知团队，而不是让其他人继续依据过时的信息工作。

scene: Investigating a production or testing bug
title_en: Investigating and Fixing a Software Bug
content_en: A tester reported that users sometimes see an error after submitting the registration form. Before changing the code, I try to reproduce the problem in a controlled environment. I follow the same steps as the tester and check whether the issue happens every time or only under certain conditions. Next, I review the browser console, server logs, and recent code changes for useful clues. The logs show that the request sometimes reaches the server without a required field. I check the form validation and discover that one field is not handled correctly when users leave it empty. I update the validation logic and add a clear error message so users know what they need to do. Then I write a test for the empty-field case and run the existing test suite to check for side effects. After the fix passes the tests, I ask the tester to verify it in the testing environment. I also document the root cause and the changes we made. A good bug fix should solve the actual problem without creating new ones. Taking time to investigate carefully is often faster than making several guesses and changing code repeatedly. If the issue cannot be fixed immediately, I share a temporary workaround with the team and keep tracking the investigation. I avoid closing the bug until the tester confirms that the original steps no longer cause the error.
content_cn: 测试人员反馈，用户提交注册表单后有时会看到错误提示。在修改代码之前，我会先在可控环境中尝试复现这个问题。我会按照测试人员相同的步骤操作，并检查问题是每次都会发生，还是只在特定条件下出现。接下来，我会查看浏览器控制台、服务器日志以及近期代码变更，寻找有用线索。日志显示，请求有时会在缺少一个必需字段的情况下到达服务器。我检查表单验证逻辑后发现，当用户将某个字段留空时，程序没有正确处理这种情况。我更新了验证逻辑，并添加清晰的错误提示，让用户知道接下来应该怎么做。随后，我针对字段为空的情况编写测试，并运行现有测试集，检查是否产生其他影响。修复通过测试后，我会请测试人员在测试环境中再次验证。我还会记录问题的根本原因以及我们所做的修改。一个好的 Bug 修复应该解决真正的问题，同时避免引入新的问题。花时间仔细排查，往往比不断猜测并反复修改代码更有效率。如果问题无法立即修复，我会先向团队提供临时解决办法，并持续跟进排查进度。在测试人员确认按照原来的步骤操作不再出现错误之前，我不会关闭这个 Bug。

title_en: Taking Part in a Code Review
content_en: Before new code is merged into the main branch, another developer usually reviews the changes. The purpose of a code review is to improve code quality, share knowledge, and catch problems early. When I open a pull request, I write a short description of what changed and why the change is needed. I also include screenshots or test steps when they help reviewers understand the result. As a reviewer, I first check whether the code matches the task requirements. Then I look at naming, readability, error handling, performance, and possible security issues. If I find something unclear, I leave a specific comment and explain the reason behind my suggestion. I try to focus on the code rather than making the discussion personal. The author can reply, update the code, or explain why a different approach is more suitable. Once the important comments have been addressed and the checks pass, the pull request can be approved. A useful review is respectful and practical, not simply a list of mistakes. Over time, regular reviews help the whole team develop more consistent coding habits. For larger changes, I may suggest breaking the work into smaller parts so that each part is easier to review. This also makes it easier to understand the history of a change if the team needs to investigate it later.
content_cn: 在新代码合并到主分支之前，通常需要另一位开发人员审查这些修改。代码审查的目的是提高代码质量、分享知识，并尽早发现问题。提交 Pull Request 时，我会简要说明修改了什么，以及为什么需要这项修改。如果截图或测试步骤有助于审查人员理解结果，我也会一并提供。作为审查人员，我首先会检查代码是否符合任务需求。接着，我会检查命名、可读性、错误处理、性能以及潜在的安全问题。如果发现不清楚的地方，我会留下具体评论，并解释提出建议的原因。我会尽量针对代码本身讨论，而不是把讨论变成针对个人的评价。代码作者可以回复、更新代码，或解释为什么另一种方案更合适。重要评论处理完毕且检查通过后，就可以批准这个 Pull Request。一次有价值的代码审查应该尊重他人并注重实际效果，而不只是罗列错误。长期坚持代码审查，有助于整个团队形成更一致的编码习惯。对于较大的修改，我可能会建议将工作拆分成更小的部分，让每一部分都更容易审查。如果团队以后需要调查某项修改，这样做也更容易理解它的变更历史。

scene: Connecting an application to an external API
title_cn: 接入第三方 API 接口
content_en: Our application needs to display shipping information from an external service, so I am responsible for integrating its API. I start by reading the API documentation to understand the available endpoints, required parameters, and response format. I also check the authentication method because the service requires an access token for each request. Before writing the integration, I test a sample request with a tool such as Postman. This helps me confirm that the credentials work and that the response contains the data we need. In the application, I keep the API key on the server instead of exposing it in the front-end code. I then create a small service module to send requests and handle successful responses and errors. Because external services may be slow or temporarily unavailable, I also consider timeouts and retry rules. I test normal responses, missing data, invalid tokens, and network failures before connecting the feature to the user interface. Finally, I add basic logging so the team can investigate problems after release. A reliable integration depends on more than making one successful request. It also needs secure credentials, clear error handling, and a plan for unexpected failures. I make sure that the integration follows the service's usage limits and does not send unnecessary requests. If the provider changes its API, clear documentation helps us update the integration with less risk.
content_cn: 我们的应用需要展示来自外部服务的物流信息，因此由我负责接入它的 API。我首先阅读 API 文档，了解可用的接口地址、必需参数以及响应格式。我还会检查身份验证方式，因为该服务要求每次请求都提供访问令牌。正式编写接入代码之前，我会使用 Postman 之类的工具测试一个示例请求。这样可以确认凭证有效，并检查响应中是否包含我们需要的数据。在应用程序中，我会将 API 密钥保存在服务器端，而不是暴露在前端代码中。随后，我会创建一个小型服务模块，用来发送请求并处理成功响应和错误。由于外部服务可能响应缓慢或暂时不可用，我还会考虑超时和重试规则。在将功能连接到用户界面之前，我会测试正常响应、数据缺失、令牌无效以及网络故障等情况。最后，我会添加基础日志记录，方便团队在功能发布后排查问题。可靠的接口集成不仅仅是成功发送一次请求。它还需要安全的凭证管理、清晰的错误处理，以及应对意外故障的方案。我会确保接口集成遵守服务的调用限制，不发送不必要的请求。如果服务提供商修改了 API，清晰的文档能帮助我们以更低的风险更新集成代码。

sentences.sentence_en: Finally, I add basic logging so the team can investigate problems after release.
sentences.sentence_cn: 最后，我会添加基础日志记录，方便团队在功能发布后排查问题。

sentences.sentence_en: A reliable integration depends on more than making one successful request.
sentences.sentence_cn: 可靠的接口集成不仅仅是成功发送一次请求。

sentences.sentence_en: It also needs secure credentials, clear error handling, and a plan for unexpected failures.
sentences.sentence_cn: 它还需要安全的凭证管理、清晰的错误处理，以及应对意外故障的方案。

sentences.sentence_en: I make sure that the integration follows the service's usage limits and does not send unnecessary requests.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我会确保接口集成遵守服务的调用限制，不发送不必要的请求。

sentences.sentence_en: If the provider changes its API, clear documentation helps us update the integration with less risk.
sentences.sentence_cn: 如果服务提供商修改了 API，清晰的文档能帮助我们以更低的风险更新集成代码。

The endpoint has three required parameters.
The access token has expired.
Send a sample request before coding.
The service should handle errors clearly.
We need to test network failures.

title_en: Preparing and Deploying a New Release
content_en: Our team plans to release a new version of the application this Friday. Before deployment, I check the release notes and confirm which features and bug fixes are included. I make sure that the code has been reviewed and that all required tests have passed. I also check environment variables, database changes, and configuration settings that may affect the release. For an important database update, we prepare a backup and confirm how to restore it if something goes wrong. We usually deploy to a staging environment first to check the release under conditions similar to production. After the final checks, we schedule the production deployment and inform the support team. During deployment, I monitor the service status, error rate, and application logs. If the update causes a serious problem, we need to roll back to the previous stable version. Once the release is stable, I update the deployment record and share the result with the team. A smooth release depends on preparation, communication, and a clear recovery plan. The work is not finished when the code is deployed; we still need to confirm that the application works for users. I avoid deploying unrelated changes at the same time because they make problems harder to identify. We also agree on who will monitor the release and who will communicate with other teams.

scene: Working with the team during a production incident
content_en: Late one afternoon, our monitoring system sent an alert because the application error rate had increased sharply. I checked the service dashboard and confirmed that some users could not complete their payments. I informed the team and started investigating the issue with another engineer. We checked recent deployments, application logs, database performance, and external service status. The problem appeared shortly after a new version was released, so we focused on the latest changes first. We found that one request was taking too long and causing other requests to wait. To reduce the impact on users, we decided to roll back the release while continuing the investigation. After the rollback, the error rate returned to normal and payment processing recovered. We then reviewed the code change and prepared a safer fix for further testing. After the incident, we wrote a report explaining the timeline, impact, root cause, and follow-up actions. The goal of an incident review is to learn from the failure rather than blame one person. Clear communication and quick coordination help the team restore service and prevent similar incidents. We also kept customer support informed so they could give users accurate information during the incident. A short, factual update is more useful than guessing about the cause before the investigation is complete.
content_cn: 一天下午较晚的时候，监控系统发出警报，因为应用程序的错误率突然大幅上升。我查看了服务监控面板，并确认部分用户无法完成付款。我通知了团队，并与另一位工程师一起开始排查问题。我们检查了近期部署记录、应用程序日志、数据库性能以及外部服务状态。问题在新版本发布后不久出现，因此我们首先重点检查最近的代码变更。我们发现有一个请求耗时过长，导致其他请求也不得不等待。为了减少对用户的影响，我们决定先回滚版本，同时继续调查问题。回滚之后，错误率恢复正常，支付处理功能也恢复了。随后，我们重新检查了代码变更，并准备了一个更安全的修复方案进行进一步测试。故障结束后，我们撰写了一份报告，说明事件时间线、影响范围、根本原因以及后续行动。故障复盘的目的是从失败中吸取经验，而不是责怪某一个人。清晰的沟通和快速协作能帮助团队恢复服务，并防止类似故障再次发生。我们也会及时告知客户支持团队，让他们在故障期间能够向用户提供准确的信息。在调查完成之前，提供简短、客观的进展说明，比猜测故障原因更有帮助。
